parameters.name: input_dir
parameters.description: Directory holding the mounted inputs. Expected to contain a 'raw' subdirectory with the core acquisition metadata and a 'processed' subdirectory with every upstream capsule's output.
parameters.help_text: Directory holding the mounted inputs. Expected to contain a 'raw' subdirectory with the core acquisition metadata and a 'processed' subdirectory with every upstream capsule's output.

parameters.name: output_dir
parameters.description: Directory where the NWB Zarr store and metadata are written.
parameters.help_text: Directory where the NWB Zarr store and metadata are written.

parameters.name: raw_subdir
parameters.description: Name of the subdirectory of input_dir holding the raw asset (core metadata, sync file, pophys movies).
parameters.help_text: Name of the subdirectory of input_dir holding the raw asset (core metadata, sync file, pophys movies).

parameters.name: processed_subdir
parameters.description: Name of the subdirectory of input_dir holding every upstream capsule's results.
parameters.help_text: Name of the subdirectory of input_dir holding every upstream capsule's results.

parameters.name: nwb_name
parameters.description: Basename of the NWB Zarr store written inside output_dir. It is written into a subdirectory, never at the results root, so that the pipeline's basename-flattening publishDir cannot collide.
parameters.help_text: Basename of the NWB Zarr store written inside output_dir. It is written into a subdirectory, never at the results root, so that the pipeline's basename-flattening publishDir cannot collide.

parameters.name: extension_namespace
parameters.description: Path to the ndx-aibs-behavior-ophys namespace YAML that defines the per-plane OphysMetadataSchema lab metadata. Resolved relative to the working directory (the capsule's code/ folder) when not absolute.
parameters.help_text: Path to the ndx-aibs-behavior-ophys namespace YAML that defines the per-plane OphysMetadataSchema lab metadata. Resolved relative to the working directory (the capsule's code/ folder) when not absolute.

parameters.name: skip_lab_metadata
parameters.description: Skip the ndx-aibs-behavior-ophys per-plane lab metadata. Use only when the extension YAML is unavailable; the resulting NWB omits imaging_depth / imaging_plane_group / field_of_view_*.
parameters.help_text: Skip the ndx-aibs-behavior-ophys per-plane lab metadata. Use only when the extension YAML is unavailable; the resulting NWB omits imaging_depth / imaging_plane_group / field_of_view_*.

parameters.name: verify
parameters.description: Round-trip the emitted processing.json and quality_control.json through the core v2 schema objects, and re-open the NWB Zarr store, after writing.
parameters.help_text: Round-trip the emitted processing.json and quality_control.json through the core v2 schema objects, and re-open the NWB Zarr store, after writing.
